testcase.name: Scenario: loft-14 Edit a placed section on a center-line loft: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/solid-model/loft/loft.feature:141:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: loft-14 Edit a placed section on a center-line loft ✔ Given a disposable copy of the native fixture "fixtures/cad/loft/circles-center-line-20.opd" is open ✔ And the user creates Loft1 from the two circular profiles and the 20 mm center line ✔ And the user edits Loft1, selects placed-sections mode, adds an intermediate section near the center-line midpoint and accepts it with alternate section size 1 ✔ When the user edits Loft1 and double-clicks the intermediate point in the preview ✔ Then Section Dimensions opens with the saved section settings ✔ When the user changes the alternate section size from 1 to 2 and accepts it ✔ Then the displayed section area doubles and the loft preview bulges ✔ When the user accepts and reopens the loft and section dimensions ✔ Then the section size remains 2 ✔ When the user sets the section position distance to 5 mm on the 20 mm center line ✔ Then the section moves and its position annotation reads 0.250000
